title: Where Allen met him: Burbank, Lionel and the Happy Landing
summary: Jiles traces his bands after the Russell recordings, including the Happy Landing job with Lionel.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Let's see now. Since you made those records for Russell, and I've known you, you said you were playing with Fairbank then. Who else did you play with in the meantime? You said you had your own band, huh? Yeah.

You mean after, with Snagy I told you I had a band, afterwards Snagy was my band. Well as the time went on, that band was on. And as we got to the part where you met us on St. Charles Street, well it was Joe's band at that time, just night. And then, from then, mid-nakes, I met you at the Happy Landing with Lionel, that was my band.
That was your band? Yeah. Who was Lionel? Lionel Fairboss.

Yeah. I know him well, of course. Yeah, well I say that's where you met me, at the Happy Landing again, from the time of St. Charles Street, you met me with Albert Boybang's voice up around Napoleon Avenue, during the time when the records was recorded with Mr. Russell. Yeah.
